Class Library

java.lang.Object
Library
public class Library extends Object
Manages the collection of books and contains all the business logic: adding, viewing, updating, deleting and changing the status of books. All input is validated here, and errors are reported with LibraryException. Books are stored in a LinkedHashMap keyed by ID. This gives fast O(1) duplicate-ID checks and lookups while keeping the order in which books were added.
Author:
Raja Muhammad Abdussamie Tahir, Arsal Zaheer
